ios.desc:
ConnectMachine is the AI-powered digital business card and contact manager. Scan, share, and remember everyone you meet.

Create unlimited cards, scan paper cards and QR codes in seconds, and let your private AI agent recall who you met, when, and why it mattered. Not a public feed. Not a follower count. Just the people you actually want to know, kept in sync with your CRM.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Create unlimited digital business cards for every context: founder, investor, speaker, personal, custom
- Scan paper business cards, QR codes, and event badges, and the AI extracts every field
- Share instantly via QR code, Apple Wallet, AirDrop, link, or email signature
- Keep a card on your lock screen via Apple Wallet for one-tap exchange
- Customize your cards with brand colors, logo, and fonts
- Quick Actions in Control Center: Scan, Share Card, Ask Concierge, Note Taker


YOUR PRIVATE AI AGENT

- Voice and text search across your network: "Who did I meet at the Austin conference?"
- AI Notetaker records meetings, assigns speakers, and shares clean summaries
- AI contact enrichment fills in missing details from public sources
- Smart event detection groups everyone you meet at the same place
- Voice notes per contact to capture first impressions before they fade
- Auto-categorization sorts contacts by relevance, not alphabet


SHARING THAT JUST WORKS

- Apple Wallet card with lock-screen live activity
- QR codes, AirDrop, SMS, email
- LinkedIn QR capture: scan any LinkedIn QR and the contact saves automatically


FOLLOW UP AND BOOK TIME

- Send a follow-up email or text in one tap from any contact
- Add a calendar link to your card so people can book time with you directly


PRIVACY AND CONTROL

- Encrypted P2P messaging with no message backups
- No screenshots, no public feed, no follow requests
- GDPR compliant, EU data stays in EU datacenters


FOR TEAMS AND BRANDS

- Team plans with shared templates so everyone presents one consistent identity
- Brand controls keep colors, logos, and design consistent across every card
- Zapier integration: every new scan and new contact flows automatically into Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Notion, Airtable, and thousands of other apps


WHO IT'S FOR

Founders, investors, executives, speakers, agency owners, and sales teams use ConnectMachine to keep their network organized and their existing CRM in sync.

HOW IT WORKS

- Create virtual cards tailored to each role
- Share via QR, AirDrop, Wallet, or scan
- Add connections
